page_title: TOU 2-3 LYO | Toulouse v Lyon 15/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) works the corner short.

90+5' Mama Balde (Lyon) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his daisy-cutter towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it. The ball is out of play. Lyon win a corner kick.
90+2' Some patient build-up play from Toulouse as they look to unlock the defence.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Vincent Sierro is replaced by Shavy Babicka (Toulouse).
89' Here comes a substitution. Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) is brought on as a substitute for Yann Gboho.
88' A player from Toulouse takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
86' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jeremy Stinat no option but to blow his whistle.
82' Dangerous play by Mikkel Desler (Toulouse). Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul.

81' 2 - 3 Jake O'Brien (Lyon) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Rayan Cherki. His header was precise and ended up inside the right post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 2:3.
81' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
80' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) produced a promising shot towards the bottom left corner after his wonderful solo run, but Guillaume Restes thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
78' Carles Martinez has decided to substitute Warren Kamanzi and he is replaced by Mikkel Desler (Toulouse).
77' 2 - 2 Rayan Cherki (Lyon) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets into the bottom right corner.
75' Lyon are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
73' Substitution. Mama Balde (Lyon) on for Corentin Tolisso.
73' Pierre Sage has decided to make a change. Malick Fofana (Lyon) replaces Ernest Nuamah.
70' Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) brings his opponent down. Jeremy Stinat has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
69' That's the end of the game for Stijn Spierings, who is replaced by Cristian Casseres (Toulouse).
69' Aron Donnum comes off the pitch to be replaced by Frank Magri (Toulouse).
67' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Toulouse is cautioned for aggressive play.
66' Here is a change. Ainsley Maitland-Niles is going off and Pierre Sage gives the last tactical orders to Rayan Cherki (Lyon).
64' Jeremy Stinat has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ernest Nuamah (Lyon).
63' Jeremy Stinat interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse).
59' 2 - 1 Goal! Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Anthony Lopes.
58' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
57' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) is penalised for holding. Jeremy Stinat signals a set piece. That is a penalty kick for Toulouse.
56' Lyon keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.

53' 1 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot into the middle of the net. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
52' Some neat passing and movement from Toulouse as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
49' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

48' A short pass finds Maxence Caqueret (Lyon). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Pierre Sage decided to make a change. Alexandre Lacazette is replaced by Gift Orban (Lyon).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
45+1' The game is interrupted. Clinton Mata (Lyon) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Guillaume Restes.
43' Stijn Spierings (Toulouse) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
43' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
42' Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) jumps into a tackle and Jeremy Stinat signals a foul.
41' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
40' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jeremy Stinat has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
38' The resulting corner from Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is cleared by the defence.
38' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
37' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
33' 0 - 1 Goal! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
33' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) picks up an accurate pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that smashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
33' Lyon are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
30' Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul after Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) hacks down one of his opponents.
29' Surely that's handball by one of the Toulouse players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
27' The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
24' Lyon are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
22' Toulouse concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
20' Lyon string together a series of short passes.
18' What a chance that is! Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
16' Jeremy Stinat interrupts the game. One of the players from Toulouse won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
13' The corner from Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) is intercepted by the defence.
12' Toulouse take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
10' Lyon control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
8' Surely that's handball by one of the Toulouse players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
7' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Lyon hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Lyon will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Jeremy Stinat.
